tbesh_html:
1) to boil, cook, bake, roast, ripen, grow ripe
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to boil, cook
1a2) to grow ripe, ripen
1b) (Piel)
1b1) to boil
1b2) to cook
1c) (Pual)
1c1) to be boiled
1c2) to be sodden
1d) (Hiphil)
1d1) to ripen
1d2) ripen, brought to ripeness

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to boil up; hence, to be done in cooking; figuratively to ripen
strongs_1890.kjv_def: bake, boil, bring forth, roast, seethe, sod (be sodden).
